message: Astra: Within “Inner Monologued:”, what can you establish about Ya na’s reception of Alex’s comforting glance, and what remains unwritten? Where would closer attention reveal whether his reassurance matters? Why would further thought be worth its time compared with attempting their next exchange now, and what unresolved uncertainty could make thinking first more valuable? What evidence would justify your choice? Could you briefly state your finding, uncertainty, and next intention in English, then carry out the step you choose?
